nodes.title: Inpainting guide
widgets_values:
Replace the masked region with a curled orange cat gently swaying its tail.

This case has its own rectangular mask. Leave room for the entire cat and tail motion; check the red overlay before generating.

Audio mask 0 preserves source audio latents. To request new sounds, change the audio prompt and mask together. Fractional audio masks do not selectively retain the school chime while adding meows.

nodes.title: Continuation guide
widgets_values:
Regenerate the ending with an overcast sky, heavy rain, and distant lightning.

Preserve fraction controls how much of the available source prefix is retained. Match Temporal Mask duration to Generate Video duration; these values are not linked.

The boundary rounds down to complete H3 chunks. White allows regeneration, but does not force existing subjects to disappear.

The red preview is schematic. Audio mask affects the entire clip, including the preserved video prefix.

nodes.title: Extension guide
widgets_values:
Extend into a summer starry night. Follow a firework rising behind the school with a slow upward camera tilt, ending at its burst.

Set the same duration in Temporal Mask and Generate Video, longer than the source. These values are not linked. The original source length determines the preserved prefix.

The boundary rounds down to H3 chunks. Preview holds the final source frame under the red overlay; it is not the generated ending.

Audio mask affects the whole clip, not only the extension.

nodes.title: Object Removal guide
widgets_values:
Reconstruct the surrounding wall inside the mask.

Set this case's Mask Canvas, Mask Rectangle, and Rectangle Position to cover the object, handle, and shadow with some background margin. Preview coverage before generating.

Symmetric expansion by d pixels: x/y minus d; width/height plus 2d. A 32-pixel margin improved this school example.

Audio mask 0 preserves source audio latents; reconstruction is not lossless.

nodes.title: Usage Guide
widgets_values:
Use a compatible MiniMax-H3 latent-edit server. Select a source video and set the server URL/model in each Generate Video node.

Select one Save Preview or Save Video output, then use Execute to selected output nodes. Running the whole workflow submits all four cases.

Mask: 0 preserves source latents; 1 regenerates. Audio mask applies to the whole clip, not individual sounds. Preview overlays are silent and do not run inference.
